title: Abelian comparison pullback on an étale slice
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $v:W	o X$ an étale object of its small étale site [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Work in a common larger universe containing the small étale and pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $
u_X$ and $
u_W$ for the comparison geometric morphisms [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The localized sites $X_{\mathrm{ét}}/W$ and $X_{\mathrm{proét}}/W$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] identify with $W_{\mathrm{ét}}$ and $W_{\mathrm{proét}}$, respectively. For an abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], restriction is $(F|_W)(T	o W)=F(T	o X)$, and likewise for $G$. There are natural isomorphisms
$$v_{\mathrm{ét}}^{-1}F\cong F|_W,\qquad v_{\mathrm{proét}}^{-1}G\cong G|_W,$$
where the inverse images are those of the geometric morphisms induced by $v$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Under these identifications the comparison pullback square gives a natural isomorphism of abelian sheaves on $W_{\mathrm{proét}}$,
$$ (
u_X^{-1}F)|_W\cong
u_W^{-1}(F|_W). $$
